div.p: Green: commands. Blue: telemetry / model state. Dashed amber: enable gates. ROS graph traffic also uses this router via rmw_zenoh_cpp (not drawn).

ul.li: Encoder feedback does not correct effort or model odometry; one encoder is suspect.
RViz may show motion while the robot is unclaimed, stalled or disconnected.
Claim is an enable gate, not authentication or exclusive ownership.
No ROS/HMI command arbitration; never drive both at once.
Shared Zenbedded keys: one robot and one controlling stack only.
Legacy UDP State egress / other sensor pipelines omitted here.

g.text: Paired samples / retain last on missing data

text.tspan: 20 B: uptime + L/R position + L/R velocity
